Infections per 100 hospital patients

Source: R/data.R
hai_rates.Rd

The share of surveyed patients who had each infection on the survey day. This measures the risk for an individual patient, regardless of how many people a country admits to hospital.

Usage

hai_rates

Format

A data frame with 10 rows and 5 variables:

country

"Germany" or "Europe".

infection

One of five infection types.

hai_patients

Number of surveyed patients with the infection.

survey_patients

Total number of patients surveyed.

per_100_patients

hai_patients / survey_patients * 100: out of every 100 patients in hospital on the survey day, how many had this infection.

Source

Zacher et al. (2019), Eurosurveillance 24(46), via the BHAI R package: https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=BHAI. Prepared in data-raw/hai.R.

Details

This is prevalence (patients infected on one day), not the number of new infections per year. It is the "per patient" view used to compare how safe hospitals are for each person treated.
